advanced-filter-description: Saringan lanjot jeuet geutuleh seubagoe teks ngon operator nyoe: == != <= >= && || ( ) Spasi geungui keu peupisah antara operator. Droeneueh jeuet saring mandum ruang khusus ngon tuleh nan ngon nilai jih. Contoh: Field1 == Value1. Catatan: Meunyoe ruang atawa nilai na spasi, droeneueh haroh boh tanda petik tunggai di keue ngon di likot jih. Contoh: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Keu escape karakter kontrol tunggai (' \/) nyan, droeneueh jeuet ngui \. Contoh: Field1 == I\'m. Droeneueh jeuet gabong le kondisi. Contoh: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngon setelan awai, mandum operator geupeubuet nibak wie u uneuen. Droeneueh jeuet ubah urutan ngon boh tanda kurong. Contoh: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Droeneueh jeuet mita ruang teks ngon regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.

Tugas nyang ka seuleusoe ("x") jak u Seuleusoe, +project ngon @context jeuet keu label, (A) jeuet keu label prioritas, due: ngon t: jeuet keu tanggai batéh ngon tanggai phon.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Tampèe hasé task export: saboh array JSON atawa saboh tugas bak tiep baréh. Tugas nyang ka lheuh geupeuduek bak Done, project ngon priority jeuet keu label, annotations jeuet keu komentar, dan depends jeuet keu meugantueng bak tugas nyang hambat.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Peuhah fail .boardarchive nibak zip dan tampèe asoe board.jsonl nibak papan, ngön baréh versi atawa hana. Sifeut peusapat lam tampilan papan jeuet keu dapeuta, sifeut pilihan laén jeuet keu label, blok teks ngon kotak tanda jeuet keu peunerangan ngon dapeuta peumeriksa, dan komentar geukeubah. Gamba ngon fail lampiran hana geupeutamong.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. States become lists, projects become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their identifier, parent, assignees, labels, dates, links and comments; priority, estimate, cycle and module become custom fields. Plane's export has no descriptions or attachments, so they are not imported.

r-wrike-workflow-note: A Wrike workflow is a list of statuses, each in the Active, Completed, Deferred or Cancelled group. Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. Wrike's own automation rules cannot be exported from Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kad milik papan nyang geutetapkan bak tim *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kad nyang tempo hingga *<n>* uroe nibak jinoe. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ peudeuih mandum kad nyang ka leupah tanggal tempo.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kad nyang geupeugot *<n>* uroe ka leupah atawa kureueng

globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - nyang *<field>* saboh nibak `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` atawa `__predicate_member__`. Peuduek `-` di keue *<field>* keu cari nyang hana na nila bak ruang nyan (umpama `has:-due` cari kad nyang hana tanggal tempo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - nyang *<sort-name>* saboh nibak `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` atawa `__predicate_modified__`. Keu susun meunuron, peuduek `-` di keue nama susun.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Operator nyang saban geupeu-*OR*. Kad nyang cocok ngon barang saboh syarat geupeuwoe.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` peuwoe kad nyang na lam senarai nan *Blocked* atawa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Operator nyang beda geupeu-*AND*. Cuma kad nyang cocok ngon mandum operator nyang beda geupeuwoe. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` peuwoe cuma kad lam senarai *Available* ngon label *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Uroe jeuet geutuleh jadi angka bulat positif atawa negatif atawa guna `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` atawa `__predicate_year__` keu periode jinoe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Pencarian teks hana beda huruf rayek ngon huruf ubit.

sandstorm-migration-description: Watee WeKan jalan lam grain Sandstorm, database MongoDB 3 lama jih geumigrasi u FerretDB v1 (SQLite) bak peuphon pertama, dan lampiran ngon avatar geupindah nibak database u direktori files/attachments dan files/avatars grain. Nyoe peudeuh peu migrasi nyan sukses dan padup ruang disk nyang mantong geupakee le file database MongoDB mentah lama lam grain, dan bri droeneueh hapus file mentah nyan keu peukosong ruang.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Hapus fail pangkalan data MongoDB meuntah
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Lheueh migrasi sukses data na bak FerretDB dan bak filesystem, jadi file database MongoDB 3 mentah lama jeuet geuhapus keu peukosong ruang disk grain. Nyoe hana jeuet geupeuwoe.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Hapus file database MongoDB 3 mentah keu peukosong ruang disk? Data ka geumigrasi u FerretDB dan filesystem. Nyoe hana jeuet geupeuwoe.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: File database MongoDB mentah ka geuhapus, ka kosong
features-desc: Fitur piléhan nyang geubri lé WeKan. Fitur nyang hana geutanda teuseumbunyi nibak ban mandum ureuëng ngui. Data jih teukeubah, idin hana meuubah.
feature-views-table-desc: Papan lagee tabel kad nyang jeuet geuatoe.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalèndè ngon kalèndè keu jai papan.
feature-views-overview-desc: Angka, peusapat meunurot ureuëng nyang geubri buet, rencana buet, papan kontrol ngon papan raya.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Daftar buet produk nyang mantöng na, masa buet paneuk, laporan masa nyan ngon bagah buet.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Buet nyang mantöng na, buet nyang ka lheuh, aliran nyang teukumpôi, watèe peubuet ngon watèe nibak peumintaan sampoe lheuh, jeumeulah buet nyang ka lheuh, trep buet preh, halangan, Monte Carlo ngon ukuran aliran laén.
feature-views-map-desc: Kad lagee tanda bak gamba nyang ka geupeuek.
feature-approval-required: Peubiyeu fitur nyang geutamah lé peubarô WeKan hana aktip sampoe admin geupeuaktip
feature-preview-admins: Admin geukalon fitur nyang hana aktip keu geucuba dilèe
feature-pilot-users: Ureuëng cuba nyang jeuet cit kalon fitur nyang hana aktip
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Nan ureuëng ngui, peupisah ngon koma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Ka teukeubah. Nan ureuëng ngui nyoe hana meurumpok:
card-field-visibility-desc: The fields of Board Settings / Card that boards can show. An unticked field is hidden from every card, minicard and Board Settings / Card of every board. No card data or board setting changes, and ticking it again shows each board as it was set. The order of the fields is each board's own.
cards-loading-auto: Otomatis (peumuat lambat keu papeun rayeuk mantong)
cards-loading-description: Pakriban tiep papan muat kad jih. Mandum kad: tiep kad geumuat u browser (paleng mudah, mandum fitur jalan, tapi papan ngon riboe kad kirem le that data u tiep ureueng kalon). Lazy: tiep senarai muat cuma kad nyang deuh jinoe (scroll hana putoh) ngon jumlah langsong, jadi papan rayeuk that pakee kureueng memori dan bandwidth. Geuatur cit le variabel lingkungan CARDS_LOADING.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Muat kad lazy sifat percobaan: pengira kad dan bataih WIP akurat, tapi kalon Kalender/Tabel/Gantt dan pileh jai cuma peudeuh kad nyang ka geumuat. Muat lom papan buka lheueh droeneueh ubah nyoe.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Watee geuhidup, mandum taut (bandua taut markdown lagee [label](url) dan tag HTML mentah <a href>) sabe geupeudeuh lagee teks biasa nyang hana jeuet geuklik bak tiep ruang teks kaya (judul papan dan kad, deskripsi, komen, checklist, dsb). Nyoe ceugah taut nyang jeuet geuklik nyang peusesat. Default mati, jadi taut mantong jeuet geuklik.
always-show-code-as-text: Sabe peudeuh mandum kode lagee teks biasa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Watee geuhidup, teks kaya hana peurnah geupeudeuh lagee markdown atawa HTML: mandum sumber sabe geupeudeuh lagee teks biasa bak tiep ruang teks kaya (judul papan dan kad, deskripsi, komen, checklist, dsb). Nyoe peudeuh isi nyang sok — komen HTML (<!-- -->), tujuan taut markdown, JavaScript dan barang kode laen — jadi mandum kode sabe deuh, hana jeuet geuklik, dan hana jalan. Default mati, jadi markdown geupeudeuh biasa.
disable-all-import-description: Watee geuhidup, mandum fitur impor geupeumati: impor papan nibak WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea dan Forgejo, dan cit clone papan. Opsi menu impor geusok dan server tulak tiep permintaan impor. Default mati.
disable-all-export-description: Watee geuhidup, mandum fitur ekspor geupeumati: ekspor papan lagee WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, atawa u NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, dan ekspor saboh lampiran. Opsi menu ekspor geusok dan server tulak tiep permintaan ekspor. Default mati.
disable-import-avatars-description: Watee geuhidup, avatar (gamba profil pengguna) hana peurnah geuimpor. Nyoe meuliput impor WeKan JSON, impor Trello, dan sinkron avatar nibak provider identitas luwa watee login (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Nan dan data laen mantong geuimpor; cuma avatar nyang geulangkah. Default mati.
disable-export-avatars-description: Watee geuhidup, avatar (gamba profil pengguna) hana peurnah geumasok watee ekspor papan (ekspor WeKan JSON dan CSV). Nama pengguna dan data laen mantong geuekspor; cuma avatar nyang hana geumasok. Default mati.
anonymize-import-users-description: Watee geuhidup, impor papan WeKan JSON ganti nan pengguna, nama leungkap dan inisial tiep pengguna geuimpor ngon placeholder pengira (user1, user2, ...), buang avatar jih, dan tuleh lom sebutan @username (dan ruang requested-by / assigned-by) lam isi kad dan komen geuimpor. Hana identitas pengguna beutoi nibak papan sumber geusimpan. Kata "user" turot bahasa ureueng nyang impor. Default mati.
anonymize-export-users: Peusom identitas ureueng ngui lam ekspor
anonymize-export-users-description: Watee geuhidup, ekspor papan ganti nan pengguna, nama leungkap dan inisial tiep pengguna geuekspor ngon placeholder pengira (user1, user2, ...), buang avatar jih, dan tuleh lom sebutan @username (dan ruang requested-by / assigned-by) lam isi kad dan komen. File geuekspor hana ba identitas pengguna beutoi. Kata "user" turot bahasa ureueng nyang ekspor. Default mati.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Watee geuhidup, ekspor papan ganti nan pengguna, nama leungkap dan inisial tiep pengguna geuekspor ngon placeholder pengira (user1, user2, ...), buang avatar jih, dan tuleh lom sebutan @username (dan ruang requested-by / assigned-by) lam isi kad dan komen. File geuekspor hana ba identitas pengguna beutoi. Kata "user" turot bahasa ureueng nyang ekspor. Default mati.
disable-activities-description: Watee geuhidup, entri feed kegiatan hana peurnah geurekam dan hana peurnah geupeudeuh dipat pih (sidebar papan dan tab kegiatan kad). Hana riwayat soe nyang peubuet peue nyang geusimpan. Default mati.
disable-notifications-description: Watee geuhidup, WeKan hana peurnah kirem pemberitahuan pantau (lam-app, emel atawa layanan laen) keu tiep kegiatan. Kegiatan mantong jeuet geurekam (keucuali geupeumati cit di ateuh); cuma pemberitahuan nyang geuceugah. Default mati.
disable-watch-description: Watee geuhidup, fitur pantau geupeumati — pengguna hana jeuet langganan papan, senarai atawa kad keu teurimong pemberitahuan, dan tiep usaha keu ubah tingkat pantau geutulak. Default mati.
backup-description: Backup Lampiran, Avatar dan/atawa Data (mandum koleksi teks nyang kon lampiran atawa avatar). File .zip geualir langsong u storan nyang geupileh — hana file sementara — lagee backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, nyang na YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars dan /data. Storan cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) guna kredensial nyang geuatur bak tab storan jih.
backup-scope-description: Bandum instans, atawa saboh organisasi. Saleunan organisasi na papeuen jih dan bandum nyang na bak papeuen nyan, meunan cit lampiran papeuen nyan — teuma hana akun ureueng ngui dan hana peungatoran instans, sabab nyan geupeugot meusapat lé bandum organisasi. Peuriwang saleunan organisasi geutuléh bak papeuen milek organisasi nyan mantong.
theme-override-all-tenants: Peungatoran nyang meuguna keu bandum penyewa
continuous-backup-description: Jikirém tieb-tieb peugantoe bak database, lampiran, avatar ngon catatan u saboh folder lam padum detik, mangat jeuet geupeuwoe u keadaan bak waktu toh mantong. Jimeukeureuja meusajan ngon saleunan nyang ka geuatoe jadwal, nyang jipeugot arsip peunoh.
continuous-backup-enabled: Peujak saleunan nyang hana putoh bak server nyoe
continuous-backup-target: Folder teumpat keubah (jalur peunoh, bak disk laén, teumpat keubah nyang geubagi bak jaringan atawa mount rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (bak waktu nyan cit, tieb-tieb peugantoe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: On SQLite (on nyang ka geugantoe bak tieb-tieb sela waktu)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Hana mèsén pangkai data nyang jeuet meukeureuja bak server nyoe
continuous-backup-key-file: File gunci kode rahasia (jalur peunoh di luwa folder teumpat keubah; 64 karakter heksadesimal atawa haba rahasia nyang na paléng kureueng 16 karakter). Keubah saboh saleunan: meunyo hana file nyoe, saleunan hana jeuet geupeubalék.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Hana u teumpat toh pih (folder teumpat keubah mantong)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: File pangkai data SQLite (geupeugot bak bineh saleunan, hana geutuleh ateueh file nyang teungoh geungui meusigoe pih)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Ngui pangkai data SQLite nyang ka geupeugot lom bak watee sistem geupeuphon lom teuma (pangkai data phon nyang geuganto teutab geukeubah)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Peuwoe generasi nyang geupileh u waktu nyang geupileh? Saleunan nyang hana putoh jipiyôh siat watee peumulihan teungoh jijak.
continuous-backup-saved: Peungatoeran saleunan nyang hana putoh ka teukeubah
backup-restore-select-first: Pileh saboh backup nibak daptar leubeh awai.
backup-restore-confirm: Peuwoe backup nyang geupileh? Lampiran/avatar geutuleh u filesystem dan data u database meunurot mode nyang geupileh.
gcs-key-filename-description: Hawa: jalur u file kunci JSON akun layanan bak server.
gcs-credentials-description: Hawa: tempel kunci JSON akun peulayanan. Peukoseng keu guna file kunci atawa kredensial default.
gcs-permissions-note: Bri akun layanan WeKan akses baca/tuleh u bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket droeneueh → Permissions → Grant access. Bak "New principals", tempel emel akun layanan — nila "client_email" nibak kunci JSON droeneueh — laju pileh peran "Storage Object Admin" dan Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Peukoseng keu simpan nila nyang na jinoe.
gcs-bucket-description: Nan bucket Cloud Storage keu simpan file.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: peukoseng (guna endpoint region). Kompatibel S3: URL Endpoint nibak konsol MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces droeneueh.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket droeneueh → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → nan bucket droeneueh (atawa Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → pengguna droeneueh → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → pileh use case 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Geupeudeuh lagee 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Layar saban ngon Access key ID; 'Secret access key' geupeudeuh cuma sigoe watee kunci geupeugot — salen watee nyan (atawa Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → nan geupeudeuh di ateuh (cit di yup Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Data storage → Containers → container droeneueh (atawa + Container keu peugot saboh).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → pemilih proyek di ateuh → ID proyek droeneueh (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → nan bucket droeneueh (atawa Create keu peugot saboh).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Jalur bak server WeKan u file kunci JSON akun layanan nyang geuunggah (geupeugot di yup). Guna nyoe ATAWA tempel JSON u ruang di yup.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akun peulayanan droeneueh → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (geuunggah file). Tempel isi jih keunoe, atawa simpan file dan atur jalur jih di ateuh.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Pindah lampiran u Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Pindah lampiran u Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Guna MongoDB GridFS keu storan file
migration-stop-confirm: Pasti droeneueh keuneuk peusudah mandum migrasi?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Keu peudeuh lampiran dan avatar, pindah nyan nibak CollectionFS u Storan laen.
s3-access-key-description: Access key AWS S3 keu autentikasi
s3-bucket-description: Nan S3 bucket keu simpan file
s3-enabled-description: Guna AWS S3 atawa MinIO keu storan file
s3-endpoint-description: URL endpoint S3 (umpama, s3.amazonaws.com atawa minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Secret key AWS S3 keu autentikasi
s3-settings-saved: Setelan S3 ka geusimpan ngon jroh
writable-path-description: Jalur direktori dasar keu storan file
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Peubuet pemeriksaan dan peugot menyeluruh keu integritas data papan, meuliput urutan senarai, posisi kad, dan struktur swimlane.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Hapus ngon aman senarai kosong ganda. Cuma hapus senarai nyang hana kad DAN na senarai laen ngon judul saban nyang na kad.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Cari dan peuwoe kad dan senarai nyang gadoh swimlaneId atawa listId. Peugot swimlane 'Kad Gadoh' keu peudeuh lom mandum item nyang gadoh.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Peuwoe mandum swimlane, senarai, dan kad geuarsip. Otomatis peugot barang swimlaneId atawa listId nyang gadoh keu peudeuh item.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Deuteksi dan peugot senarai nyang gadoh atawa reuloh lam struktur papan.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Update URL avatar keu anggota papan keu guna backend storan nyang beutoi dan peugot referensi avatar nyang reuloh.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Update mandum URL lampiran file bak papan nyoe keu guna backend storan nyang beutoi dan peugot referensi file nyang reuloh.
migrations-admin-only: Cuma administrator papan nyang jeuet peujalan migrasi
migrations-description: Peujalan pemeriksaan integritas data dan peugot keu papan nyoe. Tiep migrasi jeuet geujalan sidroe-droe.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Nyoe keuneuk peubuet migrasi menyeluruh keu cek dan peugot integritas data papan. Nyoe jeuet meujan-jan. Neusambong?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Nyoe keuneuk ubah lom barang senarai geubagi jadi senarai per-swimlane, laju hapus senarai kosong nyang na senarai ganda ngon judul saban nyang na kad. Cuma senarai kosong nyang leubeh geuhapus. Neusambong?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Nyoe keuneuk peugot swimlane 'Kad Gadoh' dan peuwoe mandum kad dan senarai nyang gadoh swimlaneId atawa listId. Nyoe cuma peungaruh item nyang hana geuarsip. Neusambong?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Nyoe keuneuk peuwoe MANDUM swimlane, senarai, dan kad geuarsip, keu peudeuh lom. Barang item ngon ID gadoh geupeugot otomatis. Nyoe hana mudah keu geupeuwoe. Neusambong?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Nyoe keuneuk deuteksi dan peugot senarai nyang gadoh atawa reuloh lam struktur papan. Neusambong?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Nyoe keuneuk update URL avatar keu anggota papan keu guna backend storan nyang beutoi. Neusambong?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Nyoe keuneuk update mandum URL lampiran file bak papan nyoe keu guna backend storan nyang beutoi. Neusambong?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Hana swimlane, senarai, atawa kad gadoh keu geupeuwoe
migration-progress-note: Neupreh watee kamoe migrasi papan droeneueh u struktur teubaro...
conversion-info-text: Konversi nyoe geubuet sigoe tiep papan dan peuget performa. Droeneueh jeuet lanjot pakee papan biasa.
converting-board-description: Ubah struktur papan keu fungsi nyang leubeh got. Nyoe jeuet meujan-jan.
migration-batch-size-description: Jumlah lampiran keu geuproses tiep batch (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Reuhat migrasi watee pemakaian CPU leubeh nibak persentase nyoe (10-90)
migration-info-text: Migrasi database geubuet sigoe dan peuget performa sistem. Proses lanjot bak latar walau droeneueh tutup browser.
migration-warning-text: Neubek tutup browser watee migrasi. Proses lanjot bak latar tapi jeuet meujan-jan keu seuleusoe.
account-locked: Akun sementara geukunci sabab le that usaha login gagai. Neuci lom teuma.
invalid-credentials: Nama pengguna atawa kata sandi salah
username-password-required: Nama pengguna dan kata sandi geupeureulee
account-created: Akun ka geupeugot! Droeneueh jeuet masok jinoe.
problems-summary-help: Piléh wilayah masalah nyang ka gata pariksa, óh lheuh nyan klik Akui keu reset jumlah masalah barô jih.
problems-in-progress-help: Peupinah atawa peu-ubat nyoe teungoh jalan. Tamong jeuet lambat, atawa jipeuleumah «Meuseuti tamong» atawa «Teungoh geumuat, neupreh», sampoe seuleusoe dan CPU treun.
problems-none-in-progress: Hana peupinah atawa peu-ubat nyang teungoh jalan.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: __fixed__ kartu ka geupeu-ubat. __unfixable__ kartu hana papeun dan hana jeuet geupeu-ubat otomatis.
restore-list-swimlanes-done: __restored__ dapheutan ka geupeu-ulang. __remaining__ hana jeuet geupeu-ulang.
export-card-details: Rincian kad (tiep kad lagee lam ekspor kad)
import-board-source: Peutamong papan (Trello, Jira, ekspor WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: Papan ka geupeugot, teuma na padum bagi lam fail nyang hana jeut geuba. Laporan nyang sama geukeubah bak Panel Admin → Masalah → Peuulang.
import-parts-instruction: Bagian nyang geucek mantong geupeutamong. Pilehan nyang saban geungui watee ekspor.
import-file-label: Choose the export file, or paste its text below:
sum-of-number-fields: Jeumeulah gata angka nyang teuma peuduek di ateuh ka bak leumbah
date-range-of-fields: Rentang tanggai field khusus jinoe tanggai nyang teutanda keu geutunyok bak ateuh list
twoFactorAuth-enabled: Otentikasi dua faktor ka hudép keu akun droe neuh.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Tamah lapèh keuamanan tamah bak akun droe neuh. Watèe ka hudép, gata harôh tuléh kode dari aplikasi otentikator tiep kai neu-login.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Scan kode QR nyoe ngon aplikasi otentikator (misal Google Authenticator, Authy), laju tuléh kode 6 angka nyang geutunyok keu peukong.
twoFactorAuth-manual-entry: Atawa tuléh kode nyoe ngon manual:
twoFactorCode-prompt: Tuléh kode otentikasi 6 angka droe neuh
twoFactorCode-invalid: Kode otentikasi hana sah. Neu-cuba lom.
subtask-done-no-permission: You cannot change whether this subtask is done
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Hana lé peu-ramai lom - bandum kartu ka trep.
chart-forecast-no-velocity: __remaining__ kartu mantong teuka; hana peusiblah teuma keu meurakoe tanggai.
chart-forecast-projected: Ngon laju akhé __average__ kartu/minggu, __remaining__ kartu nyang mantong teuka harusni trep sampoe __date__.
list-sync-description: Peusayang list nyoe geutubah teuma dari tracker luwa. Kirja latarblakang meupeuriksa tiep 15 minét; guna "Sync jinoe" keu meuriksa bagah.
drag-to-reorder: Tarék keu meuubah urutan. Tombôi panah u ateueh ngon u miyup geupeupinah saboh teumpat.
map-view-empty: Papan nyoe gohlom na gamba peta. Ureueng nyang peuatur papan jeuet peuék saboh gamba — denah lantai, peta teumpat atawa gamba tuléh — teuma kad jeuet geupeuduek di ateueh gamba nyan.
map-view-place-hint: Tarek saboh kad u ateueh peta, atawa piléh kad nyan teuma klik bak teumpat nyang patot.
map-view-all-placed: Bandum kad na di ateueh peta.

email-recovery-description: Saboh bareh keu ureueng nyang teurimong maséng-maséng. Mita ngon ID ureueng ngui. Aso peusan ngon kolom emel ureueng nyang teurimong hana geupeuleumah. Peupioh siat geutahan peusan nyang ka na ngon nyang teuma teuka; peulanjut geucuba kirem lom peusan lam daftar jinoe. Batal geuboih peusan nyang ka tamong daftar trok bak watee peumintaan. Meunyo mantong geukirem, cuba lom lheueh siat. Peusan nyang ka geupeuphon kirem hana jeuet tacok woe, ngon peungiriman nyang hana pasti hasé jih jeuet teukirem dua go. Peungiriman nyang gagal sabe ngon peusan nyang ka trok bateueh cuba geukeubah keu geupeurèksa. Cuba lom peusan nyang gagal geupeuphon putaran cuba barô ngon geujaga peupioh siat nyang ka na.

email-recovery-unavailable: Hana jeuet geubaca daftar emel. Peurèksa hak ureueng atô ngon meunyo server jeuet geungui.
email-recovery-busy: Teungoh geukirem atawa geupeubuet buet laén bak daftar. Peubarô ngon cuba lom lheueh siat.
email-recovery-failed: Buet nyoe hana jeuet geupasti. Peubarô daftar ngon cuba lom buet nyang saban meunyo peureulèe.
email-recovery-superseded: Buet nyang leubèh barô nibak ureueng peujak sistem ka geuganto peumintaan nyoe. Keuadaan daftar jinoe geupeuleumah.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Batal mandum peusan nyang jinoe lam daftar keu ureueng nyang teurimong nyoe? Aso jih geuboih ngon hana jeuet geupeuwoe lom. Peusan barô nyang geupeugöt lheueh peumintaan nyoe geukeubah.

stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
